s7-hidden-mode.base: MODE must implement S7 through MODE_AppMain using the native software-bus target command types and deterministic full-time state transitions.

cases.Startup profiles and exact recovery: initial profiles wait for registered targets, apply once in target order, explicit/same-mode rules and exact full-time quiet recovery
cases.Mode table bounds and defaults: all global/profile/restart/action bounds, allow-listed executables, conditional payload validation and pinned defaults
cases.Fault validation serials and slots: fault length/FC/type/index/node/severity/flags/name validation, per-slot wrap/duplicate/stale filtering and all slot classes
cases.Precedence SAFE recovery and disable: critical/transient demands, guarded SAFE exit, retained latches, last accepted command, enabled/disabled monitoring and reset non-effects
cases.Native restart snapshot and action order: native STOP/START target payloads and order, deferred initially-absent START, registration versus clear and table-activation snapshot preservation
cases.Cooldown recurrences cap and reset: full-time30s cooldown survives clear/reset/recurrence, three START cap, exhaustion only while active and eligible, explicit inactive reset and SAFE exit
cases.Independent peer timers and publication: own/malformed peers,10s first-contact mode deadline independent from SFI loss, diagnostics while disabled, publication and heartbeat every wakeup
cases.Mode command counter semantics: each rejected command counts once, request commands count, HK/wakeup/protocol do not, and reset clears only cumulative counters
cases.Action payloads and shared route cleanup: pinned native priority/transfer/route fields and order, last-requester release exactly once including while disabled
cases.Restart resource and exact timeouts: ascending-slot single restart resource, no attempt consumption while waiting, exact full-time STOP/START deadlines and same-wakeup continuation priority
cases.Action transmission failures: each profile/STOP/START transmission failure counts and surfaces once, later actions still execute and failed sequences end without retransmission
cases.Missing restart target isolation: no matching allow-list target skips only restart, never substitutes another executable and still consumes an attempt
cases.Initial absence clear continuation and d: absent target sends no STOP and delays START one wakeup, clear retains an in-progress restart, disable cancels it while retaining Pending/attempt/cooldown, re-enable respects eligibility
cases.Presence wins exact restart deadlines: STOP absence and START registration checked before full-time5s deadline timeout, with success at the exact deadline
cases.Accepted bounds and unsafe transfer path: accepted endpoints for globals/profiles/restarts/cooldowns/caps and rejected absolute/traversal/unterminated/empty source or nonempty destination paths
cases.Counter reset non-effects and foreign MI: all cumulative fields reset without touching mode/peer/fault/serial/attempt/timer state and unexpected MID increments one error
cases.Simultaneous demands and decision guard: simultaneous warning/critical and command precedence, transient critical even with DEGRADED response target, second guard without counter duplication, last accepted request and no disabled stale demand
